orthography: The text block has 22 lines on 68r-69v. On 70r the music ends at line 7 with a red end formula; the geometry follows (red heading at line 8, text in lines 8-22). Red initials stand in ekthesis, also at the start of lines that begin mid-sentence (68r.2 Γ, 68r.17 Τ, 68v.19 Δ, 69r.20 Ε; 70r.9 Σ in the geometry). Iota adscript appears once (ἑαυτῶι 68v.8); otherwise there is no iota subscript or adscript (τῶ, ἡμιτονίω, συντακτικῶ, ἑκάστω, τῆ, μελωδία). Movable nu is absent before consonants (ἐστι τετράχορδον 68r.19, διαστάσεσι τὸ 69r.6, διέσεσι μᾶλλον 68v.22). Elision is frequent (δ' αὐτὸ, ἀπ' αὐτῆς, δι' ἡμιτονίων, ἀλλ' ἐπεὶ, τοῦτ' ἂν, γένοιτ' ἂν, οὐδ' εἰς), but ἐφ ἑκάστω has no mark. Enclitic accentuation: τέ καὶ, μέν ἐστι. The grave is kept before punctuation (μεταφορὰ·, διαφορὰ·), and δὲ often has a double grave-like stroke (״). Breathings are small round or angular dots. ν has two forms: a v-shaped one and a μ-like one with a descender (λόγων, ταχιναῖς, κατατέμνεται), so μ and ν must be told apart from context. Common ligatures: στ, a tall ει (ꝗ-like: ἐπεὶ, εἰς, συντάττειν), εξ, ετ (μεταφορὰ, μετακινήσεσι), ου, γγ, θεν, αρ. Uncial Δ, Ε, Κ and Η stand beside minuscule forms, and κ often takes the u-form. Proper names are not capitalised (πλάτων, λύδιον, φρύγιον, δώριον). Punctuation: a high point after a main clause and a middle or low point before a predicate or between members (πρὸς δὲ τὸν δεύτερον. διπλασιημιόλιος·). There are some comma-shaped signs (68r.17, 68v.8, 68v.17, 68v.21, 69r.1, 69v.4) and a double point after the red end formula (70r.7). High and middle points are not always clearly separable. There are no diagrams or marginal scholia on 68r-70r, only the red marginal Δ sign on 70r.
